levels.surface: أبو العباس أحمد بن يحيى بن زكريا

notes: «سمعت أبي العباس يحدث» links Ibn Abbas to his father al-Abbas (rule 5); «أبي العباس» is one link, surface «العباس» (rule 7).
«فحدثتني آمنة وقالت لي» : Amina's account sits inside Abbas's narrative; she is not added. Whether she is a link is the open case, flagged for ruling.
«سألت كاهنة بني مخزوم» and the scene (the poet, the visitor) are not links; «مولى لبني مخزوم» is a patron clause; footnote numbers (1)-(3) are ignored.
